cards.title: The rack becomes the product
cards.question: Why might integration earn more than assembly?
cards.selfCheck: Pretested racks shorten deployment; test margin per delivered rack.
cards.prompt: Hypothesis: power, cooling and network integration create value beyond component resale. Dell Nov 24 reports six-hour setup; customer-side uptime and economics remain unverified. https://investors.delltechnologies.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001571996-26-000050/exhibit991earnings8kq3fy27.htm

cards.title: Dell's profit engine changes
cards.question: Is Dell capturing value beyond GPUs?
cards.selfCheck: ISG margin ~17%; test storage and networking attach.
cards.prompt: Nov 24 ISG $42B revenue and $7.1B operating income. AI servers $22B; segment margin is not AI-server margin. Already public, not a hidden stock. Compare with prior quarter and upstream KEYS/TER theses. https://investors.delltechnologies.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001571996-26-000050/exhibit991earnings8kq3fy27.htm

cards.title: 50 designs, one customer
cards.question: Does custom rack engineering become repeatable profit?
cards.selfCheck: Sep 1: some projects need 50 designs; test repeat deployments.
cards.prompt: Sep 1 call described engineering complexity and first Rubin rack shipments. Nov 24 backlog $132.3B versus $95B in September; new proof of demand, not proof of design-specific profit. Next 2–6 months: repeat deployments and service attach. https://investors.delltechnologies.com/_assets/_62d48350371e13cf7ba6bdf1e3ae1212/delltechnologies/db/3595/34748/webcast_transcript/Q2_FY27_Transcript.pdf https://investors.delltechnologies.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001571996-26-000050/exhibit991earnings8kq3fy27.htm

cards.title: The beat is already public
cards.question: Which earnings assumption could still be wrong?
cards.selfCheck: FY27 adjusted EPS guide $25.50→$29.68; test FY28 durability.
cards.prompt: Nov 24 reported beat versus $6.60 adjusted EPS consensus ($9.45 actual), per IBD. Future revisions and valuation unverified. Orders $60.2B vs $60.9B prior quarter; do not extrapolate acceleration. https://investors.delltechnologies.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001571996-26-000050/exhibit991earnings8kq3fy27.htm https://investors.delltechnologies.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001571996-26-000039/exhibit991earnings8kq2fy27.htm https://www.investors.com/news/technology/dell-stock-fiscal-q3-2027-earnings/

cards.title: DELL: wait for cash proof
cards.question: What would justify upgrading the thesis?
cards.selfCheck: WATCH: Q4 $56.3B sales guide; test cash and backlog conversion.
cards.prompt: Educational framework, not personal advice. Next quarterly report: compare $8.40 adjusted EPS guide, cash flow, ISG margin and cancellations. Reject sustained margin deterioration or funding-driven order deferrals. Compare price with normalized FY28 earnings; no verified current multiple. https://investors.delltechnologies.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001571996-26-000050/exhibit991earnings8kq3fy27.htm

cards.title: Orders need land and power
cards.question: Why can a huge backlog fail to become revenue?
cards.selfCheck: Track funded sites, energized capacity and accepted racks.
cards.prompt: Dell says it vets customer capital, land and power. This is management's claim, not independent verification. Build a cohort conversion model; compare orders, shipments, cancellations and cash. Nov 24 chip selloff despite Dell's after-close beat illustrates separate price and operating clocks. https://investors.delltechnologies.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001571996-26-000050/exhibit991earnings8kq3fy27.htm https://www.reuters.com/business/wall-st-futures-dip-chip-stocks-cool-after-nvidia-fueled-rally-2026-11-24/
